confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of South Korean provincial pricing, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak summer and Jeonju's hanok-village guesthouses price above ordinary hotels. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2.5x beer, wine glass about 2.25x beer). The FX observation is the RBA AUD/USD figure for 2026-10-15 as reported in a search summary of the rba.gov.au exchange-rates overview page; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Korean regional cities outside Seoul (for example Gwangju and Daejeon), adjusted for Jeonju's strong food-tourism draw and hanok-village guesthouse demand.
